Frozen schema-v1 build-home datasets: live, dense, newrepo, noqueue and offline.
The source serves initial active-day windows and earlier pages from these full-index fixtures.
The hostile fixture carries a snapshot plus an invalid UTF-8 title encoded in base64.
The manifest maps original design ids to bare ticket identifiers.
From src/browser, run `npm run fixtures:build-home` to regenerate and `npm run check:build-home-fixtures` to check.
The vendored design-source remains unchanged; open feature ends map to null and intake restores Infinity.

The synthetic odd-edges dataset is registered in `extra_datasets`, outside the design parity matrix.
It covers cycles, a self-loop, missing blockers, a violation and unknown order.
Its companion odd-edges-history.json stores History inputs and expected edge projections.

The extra now0 and now24 datasets exercise empty and tall live bands. Their exporter
and reference-browser tests share build-home-now-patch.mjs, applied only in memory.
Now-band parity aligns the whole composed viewport at an integer raster origin;
mobile headers use no masks. Tall bands compare the full visible scrollport, with
all card geometry checked separately. The fixture forces a fresh viewport paint
after relocation and checks focus/scroll preservation. Preset pixels cover their
pill strip; filtering behind the blurred band belongs to C10-T02. Only the pending
C7-T03 ETA copy is masked in band captures.

Usage and offline panels are hidden on both fixture pages where they would paint
behind the relocated board’s rounded corners.
